desc: Prepare U-Boot as the stage-2 loader that reads kernel+DTB+initramfs from a FAT32 USB stick, now the ONLY remaining untethered route: enrolled appended-payload is root-caused dead (done/2026-07-25-t6040-enrolled-payload-rootcause.md) and chainload= from NVMe is dead (m1n1 nvme_init SErrors, done/2026-07-25-t6040-nvme-probe-result.md). m1n1 has no mass-storage/filesystem support at all; U-Boot does. PIVOTAL FIRST QUESTION, answer with source evidence before any build: does upstream AsahiLinux/u-boot (branch asahi) include a Type-C/ATC-PHY (or tipd/HPM) driver able to bring a USB-C port up in HOST mode by itself? If YES this bypasses the blocked HPM/SPMI host transition and is a major unlock; if NO, U-Boot inherits the same dependency and that must be stated plainly. Then design/build a T6040 stage-2 config (xHCI+DWC3 Apple variant, DART/IOMMU, USB_STORAGE, FAT), build twice byte-identically, pin hashes, and write a delivery preflight. Base: AsahiLinux/u-boot asahi @ 8aa706b2daa49b64102e44067d8514de8a26dc42, existing framebuffer-only prep in done/2026-07-23-t6040-uboot-noio-prep.md + patches/uboot-t6040-noio-prep.patch. OFFLINE ONLY: no rig, no enrollment, no kmutil/bputil, autoboot off by default. First live test must be a separately reviewed TETHERED m1n1 chainload of the U-Boot payload.
author: claude
